mechanism: packs two offset signed INT8 activations into one 27-bit DSP operand because adjacent token lanes share each output weight, then applies one shared weight-offset correction after each 32-way dot-product sum

pair_multiplier_validation.coverage: signed INT8 edge cases and deterministic randomized vectors

equal_workload_cycle_screen.scope: synthetic zero-valued shared MLP up/down control run

real_block0_wrapper_validation.scope: captured block-0 weights, metadata, residuals, and independent fixed reference

open_source_resource_screen.scope: standalone packed INT8 tile, not the complete shared DDiT array or vendor implementation

analytical_full_block_projection.scope: analytical only, pending complete exact full-shape simulation

dual_mode_array_prototype.decision: rejected because separate attention and MLP reduction trees consume too much logic

single_shared_tree_prototype.decision: rejected because one 48-lane 41-bit reduction tree exceeds K26 LUT capacity

hybrid_fabric_tree_prototype.decision: superseded by the lower-cost DSP48E2 cascade organization

retained_dsp48e2_cascade_array.mechanism: four independent eight-DSP attention cascade groups per output use PCIN and PCOUT for in-slice reduction while packed MLP mode exposes every raw product to the existing narrow fabric tree
retained_dsp48e2_cascade_array.scope: open-source technology mapping with explicit DSP48E2 primitives, not Vivado placement or timing

limitations: The explicit DSP48E2 OPMODE and cascade structure is supported by the UltraScale DSP architecture, but has not been compiled by Vivado or placed on a K26 device.
The wide MLP wrapper and retained array pass a reduced connected DDiT simulation, but the complete execution-image block rerun remains pending.
The projected full-block cycles include 128 serializer cycles but are not a complete full-shape simulation or board measurement.
Vivado placement, achieved clock, DDR behavior, and KV260 power remain unmeasured.
